title: Pages & Guides
description: Add pages to a document, pull guides onto a page, and open Page Setup — paper, margins, and print range.

bubble.title: Pages & Guides
bubble.body: A document is a stack of pages, each with its own artwork and its own ruler guides. This section adds pages and guides, and opens Page Setup.

bubble.title: Watch: the shape of a document
bubble.body: The demo points at the moving parts: the page list, the guide row, and Page Setup. Adding pages and guides is a button press and a drag — yours, in the next steps.

demo.title: Pages across the top
demo.body: Each page is a separate sheet with its own layers and guides. The page list switches between them.

demo.title: Guides below
demo.body: Guides are ruler lines that live on one page: pull them from the rulers, or add one by number in this section.

bubble.title: Add a page
bubble.body: Open the Pages & Guides preview and click Add page. A fresh page appears in the list and becomes the page you are looking at — the first page keeps its artwork.

bubble.title: Add a guide by number
bubble.body: In the Pages & Guides preview, pick an axis and a position and add the guide. It lands at exactly that position on this page. Show guides on the bar turns those lines on and off.

bubble.title: Drag a guide from the ruler
bubble.body: Guides also come straight off the rulers: press on the top ruler and drag down onto the canvas; a horizontal guide follows your cursor and drops where you release. Dragging it later moves it.

bubble.title: Open Page Setup
bubble.body: Open the Pages & Guides preview and click Page Setup…. Paper size, margins, and the print range live there — they describe how this document prints, not how it draws. Close it when you have seen it.

bubble.title: Pages are documents within the document
bubble.body: Each page keeps its own artwork, layers, and guides, and the file saves them all. Saving & Exporting covers getting pages out of the program.
